observation: Original has a modal discount popup ('Hurry up! We are now offering discount for new customers!') overlaying the top of the page, with a stock photo, red headline, bright-blue 'Get My Discount!' button and a dimming semi-transparent dark overlay; the AI-built page has no popup.

Original opens with a navy band holding a long centered paragraph of FSA/CBD news text; the AI-built page moves that news into a mid-page 'IN THE NEWS' section, left-aligned and capped at about 800px, with an eyebrow, h2, grey intro and a five-item gold-bulleted list.
Original has no h1, and its outline starts with an h4 followed by ten h2s; the AI-built page has one h1 ('Find CBD cream and oil for everyday relief'), 6 h2s and 12 h3s in a clear hierarchy.
Both pages use SEO keyword phrases in title case as headings and product titles ('Cbd For Life', 'Pure Cbd', 'Cbd Oil Amazon', 'Cbd'), and these don't match the actual products.

Original uses keyword-style alt text that often doesn't match the image, with 1 image missing alt; the AI-built page has 0 missing alts, descriptive alts on hero, category and product images, and empty alts on featured and wide-card images.

Original hero is a full-width slider of three stacked 700x300 images upscaled to 1440x617, with baked-in 'GIFT 1' banner text; the AI-built hero is a two-column dark-green gradient band with an eyebrow, h1, paragraph and gold CTA on the left and a 503x340 photo on the right.
Original hero shows a visible horizontal color seam around y≈900, as if a transition is mid-state.
AI-built page has a large white bold 51.2px system-sans h1 with an uppercase letter-spaced eyebrow ('CBD OILS · EDIBLES · TOPICALS') above it.

Original header is a light-gray strip with a top utility line (phone/email/Contact Us), a logo, a rounded pill search field and a green rule between two nav rows; the AI-built page has a separate dark-green utility bar (hours, phone, Contact Us) above a white header with logo, text site name, a centered nav and a search form with a square green icon button.

Original nav is a multi-row menu of long keyword labels in a small serif face, plus a 'Menu' button with left icon padding; the AI-built nav is a single row of five short sans links (Shop, Products, Learn, News, Contact Us) with no dropdown indicators.

Original shows a 325x97 full-color 'Z' badge logo alone (alt 'Buy Cbd Oil Online'); the AI-built page pairs the logo (alt 'CBD logo') with a text site name 'Where To Buy Cbd Cream For Pain', which conflicts with the Zatural brand mark.
AI-built page shows a 'Cart (0)' link as an outlined box that wraps onto a second header row.

Original category area is three side-by-side tiles with distinct solid colors (green, amber, blue), ghosted background words, jar photos and white 'SHOP NOW' pills; the AI-built 'Shop by category' is four equal white bordered rounded cards with cropped 255x191 photos and caption bars.
Both pages use a centered fixed content column with wide side margins on the 1440px canvas: about 1170px (x≈135–1305) on the original and about 1088px (x=176–1264) on the AI-built page.
Original layout uses no CSS grid and only 12 flex elements (float/width-based legacy WordPress theme); the AI-built page uses 12 grid and 18 flex containers.
Original h2s are 36px, weight 600, navy, in a rounded serif face; AI-built h2s are 27.2px, weight 700, in system sans.

Both pages show four product cards in a row with a square photo, title and price ('From $14.99', '$29.99', etc.). The original uses white cards with soft shadows, small radii and 259x259 images; the AI-built page uses bordered rounded cards with no shadow, 255x255 images and an added grey descriptor line.
Both pages mark sale items with a struck-through old price $59.99 beside $49.99. The original uses a green notched 'SALE!' ribbon at the top-left; the AI-built page uses a gold 'On sale' pill badge.

Original presents featured topics ('Cbd Vape', 'Charlotte's Web Cbd Oil', 'Lazarus Naturals') as alternating two-column blocks: a 549px image beside a stretched white card holding mostly blank space. The AI-built page uses a three-column card grid where the fourth card wraps alone onto a second row.

Original content-card CTAs ('More CBD Questions?', 'Click Here for More About CBD', 'Learn More') are navy pill buttons with white serif text; on the AI-built page the same labels are underlined green text links.

Both pages use photos with baked-in marketing text ('ZATURAL', 'FULL SPECTRUM', 'PURITY / PLACE / PRICE') that gets cut off. On the original, cropping at the image edge clips it; on the AI-built page, square sources cropped into landscape frames truncate it further.

Both pages use the faded cannabis-leaf overlay image for the 'Cbd Clinic Products' item. On the original it is a full-width banner background with a centered title and two large underlined links separated by a divider; on the AI-built page it is a small washed-out photo in the fourth featured card.

Original ends its content with three navy-framed square image tiles (Aromatherapy, CBD vs Hemp, 5 Ps); the AI-built page shows two wide linked image cards ('CBD versus hemp', 'The 5 Ps of CBD') with 532x299 crops and a dark navy caption strip.

Original palette is deep navy rgb(21,42,81) dominant (text on 454 elements) with green accent rgb(47,126,60), black body text and a lavender-tinted off-white background rgb(249,249,252); the AI-built palette is forest green rgb(31,65,48)/rgb(47,93,67) with gold accent rgb(201,162,75), dark green-black text rgb(31,42,36) and a warm off-white background rgb(250,248,243).

Original mixes several web fonts (Cooper-like serif on 601 elements, Alegreya Sans, Alegreya, JudgemeStar, Lucida Grande, Font Awesome Brands); the AI-built page uses only a system-ui sans stack (370 elements) plus Arial on 2, with no web fonts.
Both pages set body text at 16px with about a 1.6 line height: 25.888px on the original, 25.6px on the AI-built page.
Original corners are overwhelmingly square (677 at 0, only 9 at 16px+, 7 pills); the AI-built page rounds many elements (88 at 16px+, 19 at 8–15px) while 262 remain square.

Original has 10 box shadows, 206 transitions, 1 animation, 11 transforms and no gradients; the AI-built page has no shadows, transitions, animations or transforms and one gradient (the hero). Neither uses backdrop blur.

Both pages have a four-column footer with a '© CBD Oil 2020' copyright and a payment-icons image at the bottom. The original is navy, with newsletter/social in the first column ('Join The Club', Company, Support, Contact Us) and a light copyright strip; the AI-built footer is near-black green (Contact, Company, Support, Follow us) with muted grey-green links and a divider before the copyright row.

Original puts the 'Join The Club' newsletter in a footer column as a white pill input with a check icon, plus five circular Font Awesome social buttons; the AI-built page gives it a full-bleed dark-green two-column band with a white input and a gold 'Sign up' button.
Both pages are link-dense with few paragraphs. The original has 241 anchors, 206 li, 17 p and 391 words; the AI-built page has 124 anchors, 110 li, 9 p and 512 words.

Original carries heavy markup and assets: 54 scripts, 31 stylesheets, 52 inline style attributes, 23 style tags and 1300 class uses. The AI-built page has 1 script, 0 external stylesheets, 1 style block, 7 inline styles and 82 class uses.

Both pages use one header, nav, main and footer with no aside. The original has 8 sections, 1 article and 9 figures without captions; the AI-built page has 7 sections, 8 articles (cards) and no figures.

Original head has Open Graph/Twitter meta, robots and keywords, title 'CBD Oil & Cream - CBD Products - CBD Store' and lang en-US; the AI-built head has only charset, viewport and description, title 'Where To Buy CBD Cream For Pain' and lang en.
Original copy uses exclamation-mark urgency (5 exclamations, 'Hurry up!'); the AI-built page has 0 exclamations.
Both pages include the dated FSA editorial copy, including the 31 March 2021 deadline. The AI-built page highlights the deadline in a pale cream, gold-bordered callout box.
Original page is 4987px tall; the AI-built page is 4335px tall, with sections alternating between off-white, white, green and dark bands.
Original has 16 buttons, 14 inputs and 3 forms (some hidden); the AI-built page has 2 buttons, 2 inputs and 2 forms (search and newsletter).
AI-built page has a 'Popular searches' area with about 23 keyword links as white bordered pill chips.
AI-built page uses a native details/summary 'Show all topics' disclosure that hides about 62 more keyword links, rendered collapsed.
Original uses Font Awesome brand icons for social links; the AI-built page uses no icon fonts or SVG, only raster PNGs (a 16x16 search magnifier and the payment strip).
AI-built page repeats contact details in three places (top bar, header nav, footer Contact column), and the footer email line has no address.
AI-built page makes whole category and wide image cards single links wrapping the image and caption, and underlines in-card and top-bar text links while leaving nav and footer links plain.
